description: This file defines a Flutter widget representing a category tab in a news app, displaying a list of articles with loading shimmer effect and navigation to detailed article view.

classes.name: CategoryTab
classes.description: A stateless widget displaying a list of news articles for a specified category, with loading shimmer and refresh functionality.

classes.name: _ShimmerList
classes.description: A private stateless widget that displays a shimmering placeholder list during loading states.

methods.name: _open
methods.description: Navigates to the ReadArticleScreen with the selected article.
